summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward ultra-long-term bullish bets on the S&P 500, evidenced by massive $170M+ accumulations in SPX 7000C and 7675C strikes for 2026 and 2027. There is extreme directional conviction in the SPX 7000C series, with persistent multi-day buying totaling over $1.8B across the 2026-09, 2026-10, and 2026-12 expiries. While massive SPX 8000P positions exist, they appear to be long-dated tail-risk hedges against the aggressive call accumulation. Traders should monitor for continued strength in NVDA and GLD, given their extremely low P/C ratios (0.29 and 0.14 respectively), which signal intense single-sided call buying.
